gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve the list of dynamic modules registered in the Jira Cloud platform so that I can manage their configurations.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array containing the details of all registered dynamic modules, including their IDs, types, and statuses.

gold.user: As an app administrator, I need to register new dynamic modules for my Jira app to enhance its functionality and user experience.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with module details and return a success message along with the ID of the newly registered module.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to remove specific dynamic modules from my Jira instance to clean up unused features and improve performance.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a module ID and return a confirmation message indicating that the module has been successfully removed.
